answer.rationale: Do not match the competitor with broad discounts: the recovered SMB pricing test lifted acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, undermining sustainable qualified revenue. Shortened onboarding is confirmed to improve time-to-value, adoption, and retention, while signup simplification has durable SMB activation benefits. Roll it out broadly and monitor price-sensitive SMB churn; this addresses value realization without creating a low-retention cohort.
